en.name: Spellbook Genius of Prophecy
en.effect: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. If you have "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your field or GY: You can banish 1 Spell from your GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand. During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 Spell from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; change it to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Spellbook Genius of Prophecy" once per turn.
